title: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE — Amazon Bedrock Mantle Support (v2.1.94)
description: New env var enabling Claude Code to use Amazon Bedrock powered by Mantle (AWS's next-gen inference routing layer). Set CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE=1 alongside Bedrock credentials. Relevant for enterprise teams on AWS infrastructure seeking lower latency or reserved capacity routing. Not applicable to Max plan users (different auth path).

evaluation.reasoning: Explicitly not applicable to Max plan users (different auth path). Zero integration complexity and zero capability expansion for this stack. Enterprise-only feature with no reconsideration trigger unless switching to Bedrock auth.
